recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source change is recommended for FHIR-40274 unless a future work-group decision changes Requirements reference URL-vs-canonical guidance handled by separate issues.
issue_request: FHIR-40274 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Requirements. The reporter clarified that Requirements.statement.reference was not enough and that Requirements.reference was needed at the root as well, distinct from derivedFrom relationship tracking.
initial_application: Upstream commit d952e4376ba8552b69effbfba35a5f3808b8da98, titled "FHIR-40274 - add Requirements.reference", added the missing Requirements.reference element to source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml while leaving Requirements.statement.reference in place.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively registers requirements=Requirements and marks Requirements normative, so the checked Requirements StructureDefinition source is current build input. FHIR-I minutes show an initial 2023-02-06 derivedFrom-based no-new-root-reference disposition, then the 2023-02-27 Persuasive vote that matches the Jira final state. Later Requirements work such as FHIR-42721 clarified URL guidance for both reference elements without removing either; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the latest combined branch already defines Requirements.reference and Requirements.statement.reference as 0..* url elements for the external artifact that created the requirement set or statement.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue clarified Requirements.reference and Requirements.statement.reference URL guidance without changing FHIR-40274's two-level reference placement; it already has its own combined-branch audit commit.

Later Applied issue reworked statement derivedFrom/partOf relationship references, reinforcing that derivedFrom remains a separate relationship concept rather than a substitute for Requirements.reference.
